description: Adds a doc to the playbook Iris reads, scoped to the brands and addresses you give it. Use it to record a price list, an argument that works or a rule to follow, once, where every future draft will find it.

addresses.description: The inbound addresses this doc applies to, from list_sender_addresses. An empty list applies it to every address of the brands above.

brands.description: The brand slugs this doc applies to, from list_brands. An empty list applies it to the whole account.

content.description: The doc itself, in Markdown. This is the text Iris reads before drafting.

sort_order.description: Where the doc sits in the reading order, lowest first.

title.description: The title of the doc, unique in the account.

name: create_knowledge
title: Add a knowledge doc
